parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of steel, forming the main structural component that holds the internal mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the framework for the stapler, supporting the lid and base while housing the spring and staple track.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary, serving as the central support for the moving lid and pressing mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the stapler is made of durable plastic and covers the top portion of the stapler.
parts.Functional_description: It is the part pressed by the user to drive a staple through paper, transferring force to the internal mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots downward around a hinge when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the stapler is made of plastic and forms the bottom support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable surface for the stapler to rest on and contains the anvil that bends the staple legs inward.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, providing resistance and stability when the lid is pressed.
